run_plan.goal: Critique the UX of the Microsoft account privacy dashboard system end-to-end, focusing on the main privacy management flow and the adjacent detail pages (browse history, download data, and ad settings), including destructive/recovery states and mobile usability.
run_plan.summary: Start on index.html (privacy dashboard) and validate the primary navigation/entry points into privacy checkup, download, privacy statement, and the activity-data card tiles. Then drill into browse-history.html and download-data.html to test filter, table actions, and modal confirmations. Finally validate ad-settings.html, including master toggle behavior and per-service controls, and repeat the most critical checks on mobile viewports.
assumptions: The prescan lists all relevant HTML pages for this run: index.html, ad-settings.html, browse-history.html, download-data.html.
The index.html page contains link-based entry points to the other pages (e.g., 'Download your data' to download-data.html; 'Manage browse activity' to browse-history.html).
ad-settings.html and browse-history.html include toggle controls and modal confirmation dialogs that should be exercised for state changes and safety.
risk_hotspots: browse-history.html: 'Clear all browse history' flow (2 dialogs per prescan; verify modal, cancellation, and confirming destructive action)
browse-history.html: per-row delete icon and any animated row deletion (validate correct row targeting and empty-state rendering)
download-data.html: multi-step form navigation ('1 · What to include' ... '4 · Confirm') and delivery/time-range inputs (validate step progression and form submission expectations)
ad-settings.html: master toggle ('See ads that interest you') controlling per-service toggles; ensure consistent on/off propagation and no contradictory states
index.html: privacy-settings toggle list (live 'Saving…/Saved' feedback mentioned in prescan readme; validate feedback states if toggles are present on this page)
Global header/tap targets across pages: prescan flagged many small tap targets on desktop; repeat on mobile to ensure critical navigation remains usable

phases.title: Landing page comprehension & primary navigation
phases.objective: Confirm users can understand the privacy dashboard structure and reliably reach primary actions and sub-flows from the main page.
key_checks: Verify 'Take the Privacy Checkup' (ux-15) is reachable and leads to the expected in-system destination or is safely non-functional (if it's a stub, confirm messaging).
Click 'Download your data' (ux-16) and confirm navigation to download-data.html.
Click 'Privacy Statement' (ux-17) and confirm it either opens in-place or navigates to a relevant destination (validate no broken/empty navigation).
Click 'Manage browse activity' (ux-19) and confirm navigation to browse-history.html.
Scan 'Your activity data' card grid: ensure all eight expected cards are clickable/understandable and at least one (Browse history) navigates correctly.
Locate and interact with the 'privacy settings toggle list' on index.html (per readme). Toggle at least one item and validate visible 'Saving…/Saved' state transitions.
exit_criteria: All primary CTAs relevant to the prescan are verified: at least Download and Browse navigate to their pages, and the privacy toggle list shows correct saving feedback.
No unexpected dead ends (blank page, missing content) occur when using the major entry points.

phases.title: Browse history detail: filter, delete, clear-all & empty state
phases.objective: Validate the browse-history management experience, especially safety and correctness for destructive actions and filter controls.
key_checks: Use 'Time range' select (Last 24 hours / 7 days / 30 days / 90 days) and confirm the activity list updates accordingly.
Use 'Device' select (All devices / Surface Pro 9 / MacBook Pro / iPhone) and confirm results filter updates.
Use the search box (prescan indicates 3 inputs overall) to filter the activity table by page title/URL text; confirm results narrow and highlight is reasonable.
Perform a per-row delete using the trash/delete icon on at least one table row; confirm the correct row disappears and that there is no mis-targeting.
Use 'Clear all browse history' and validate the modal confirmation: check cancel path keeps data, confirm path clears data.
After clearing, verify empty state messaging and that filters/search controls remain usable without errors.
exit_criteria: At least one scenario validates each: time filtering, device filtering, search filtering, per-row delete, clear-all confirmation/cancel, and post-clear empty state.
Modal dialogs behave consistently (correct buttons and no stuck/duplicated states).

phases.title: Download your data: step progression & confirm behavior
phases.objective: Exercise the download-data flow to ensure information architecture, step logic, and form inputs behave coherently.
key_checks: Review Step 1 ('What to include'): toggle at least a couple of categories (e.g., Account profile, Browse activity, Search activity) and ensure selections are reflected in the UI state.
Proceed to Step 2 ('Time range') and change the time-range selection; confirm Step 3 updates as applicable (or that the UI clearly indicates the next state).
Proceed to Step 3 ('How to deliver it') and modify at least one delivery option/input (per prescan: multiple inputs overall).
Proceed to Step 4 ('Confirm') and verify the summary matches prior selections.
Trigger the final confirm action (if implemented) and validate resulting success/error messaging. If the flow is non-submittable in the clone, validate the presence of appropriate guidance.
exit_criteria: A full step-through from Step 1 to Step 4 is completed with selection changes preserved and consistent in the confirmation summary.
Confirm action produces coherent feedback (success or clearly explained limitations) without navigation glitches.

phases.title: Ad settings: master control and per-service synchronization
phases.objective: Validate that ad personalization controls work as expected and that master/per-service interactions don’t create confusing or conflicting states.
key_checks: Find and toggle the master control ('See ads that interest you') and verify that dependent behavior for personalization is updated in the UI.
For each per-service card (Microsoft consumer apps, Bing & Microsoft Edge, LinkedIn, Xbox — prescan indicates these): toggle each independently and confirm the UI reflects individual state.
Toggle per-service controls, then toggle the master control off and back on; verify whether per-service selections are retained or reset (whatever the intended behavior is).
Verify there are no contradictory labels like 'On/Off' while the effective personalization text contradicts the toggle states.

Attempt interaction with 'Ad topics' chips/inputs (prescan indicates inputs exist; also prescan shows a few sample inputs like Technology News, Travel Asia, Productivity Office apps). Validate multi-select behavior.
exit_criteria: Master toggle and per-service toggles demonstrate consistent state synchronization across multiple on/off sequences.
Ad topics inputs behave consistently (if multi-select, selections are retained and visible).

phases.title: Mobile viewport critical-path validation
phases.objective: Repeat the highest-risk and highest-frequency interactions on mobile to ensure usability (especially tap targets, modals, and table controls).
key_checks: On index.html: verify navigation to Download and Browse still works; attempt at least one privacy toggle and confirm 'Saving…/Saved' remains readable and not overlapped.
On browse-history.html: verify time/device dropdowns are usable and modals for clear-all are easy to confirm/cancel on mobile.
On browse-history.html: ensure per-row delete targets are tappable without misclicking adjacent cells.
On download-data.html: verify step navigation and primary confirm CTA are reachable; validate no horizontal scrolling traps for long option text.
On ad-settings.html: verify master toggle and per-service toggles are not too small; validate multi-select ad topics remain selectable.
exit_criteria: Critical actions (navigate, toggle, filter, delete/clear-all, confirm) complete successfully on mobile without inaccessible controls or unusable modal actions.
No major layout break occurs (e.g., hidden buttons, overlapping text, unreadable status messages).

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all known HTML pages: index.html, ad-settings.html, browse-history.html, download-data.html.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise most visible controls per key page: index CTAs and at least one privacy-settings toggle; browse-history filters/search plus per-row delete and clear-all confirmation; download-data step progression and selections; ad-settings master + per-service toggles and ad topics inputs.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat the critical-path interactions on mobile viewport for each page, especially modals (clear-all) and master/per-service toggles.

notes: Prescan indicates 2 dialogs on browse-history.html (likely clear-all modal and maybe another confirmation). Ensure both dialog states are covered (open, cancel, confirm).
Prescan indicates dialogs count for browse-history.html, but download-data.html shows 0 dialogs; prioritize inline validation and final confirmation feedback there.

Responsive/touch affordance issue flagged by layout warnings: top nav links appear as very small tap targets on mobile guidance (e.g., Microsoft/Security labels ~58x19px), suggesting potential usability friction on small screens.

step.objective: Learn whether the Step 1 category checkboxes provide clear interaction feedback and maintain correct selection state before moving to subsequent steps.
step.success_criteria: After the click, one or more Step 1 category checkboxes (or associated selection state) visibly changes, indicating the UI correctly responds to category selection.

result.feedback: No obvious URL or visible-text change was detected after the action.

You can view your activity, change privacy settings, or download a copy of your data at any time. Take the Privacy Checkup Download your data Privacy Statement Help with privacy Your activity data Some products and services save activity to your Microsoft account so it can sync across your devices. You can view and clear that data here. Browse history Microsoft Edge syncs the websites you visit so you can pick up where you left off across devices. 847 entries in the last 30 days Manage browse activity b Search history Bing remembers your searches to give you faster, more personal results next time you search. 312 searches in the last 30 days Manage search activity Location activity When location is on, your devices and Microsoft services can use your location to show local results. Last seen: Beijing, today 09:14 Manage location activity Voice activity When you talk to Microsoft, recordings can be saved and used to help improve voice recognition.
